name: clay
description: A plasticine claymation cast in a snowy storybook forest. The boss runs the workshop, the worker hauls everything on the sled, the analyst keeps the accounts straight.
style: handmade plasticine claymation in the style of a stop-motion film, soft rounded clay sculptures with visible fingerprint and tooling texture, matte surfaces, gentle warm studio lighting, cosy winter-storybook palette of warm browns, cream snow, deep pine green and knitted red, everything looks sculpted from modelling clay

background.prompt: A snowy forest clearing at dusk seen straight on, sculpted entirely from clay. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a deep dusk-blue forest of snow-dusted pine trees fading into soft darkness, the trees tall only at the extreme left and right edges. A small log cabin with a snow-covered roof and warm glowing windows sits against the extreme right edge, no taller than a quarter of the image. Lower third: a rolling cream snow field stretching the full width with tiny clay footprints and snow lumps. Wide open empty snow middle with nothing in it.

boss.role: owns the workshop and the capital - wants the sleds loaded and the bills paid
boss.look: a plump clay figure with a round body, bushy sculpted eyebrows, a brown clay waistcoat over a cream shirt, a small red necktie, stubby legs, chunky rounded hands

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands resting on his round belly, pleased expression
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one hand, mouth open, giving an order
poses.greedy: standing with both hands clasped together, wide delighted grin, eyes closed happily
poses.worried: standing with both hands raised near his face, brows pinched together
poses.think: standing with one hand under his chin, brow furrowed, thinking hard

worker.role: does the hauling - the one the snow actually falls on
worker.look: a small round clay figure in a chunky knit mustard hat with a pompom, a thick red knitted scarf, a warm brown clay coat and boots, rosy cheeks, a small round nose

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at the sides, soft content smile
poses.pull: leaning forward gripping an invisible rope with both hands behind the shoulders, hauling hard, cheeks puffed
poses.tired: standing with drooping shoulders and half-closed eyes, scarf hanging loose
poses.happy: standing with both short arms raised in delight, wide smile
poses.confused: standing with one hand scratching the side of the knit hat, puzzled

analyst.role: keeps the ledger and explains what the numbers mean
analyst.look: a tidy clay figure with round wire glasses, a mustard knitted bobble hat, a cream clay sweater with a knitted diamond pattern, a small green scarf, holding nothing

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands folded in front, calm expression
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand turned upward, mid-explanation
poses.point_up: standing and pointing straight upward with one index finger, making a point
poses.think: standing with one hand at the chin, head tilted, considering

props.log_cabin: a small clay log cabin with a snow-covered roof, warm glowing windows and a smoking chimney, complete and self-contained
props.wooden_sled: a small clay wooden sled with curved runners and rope handles, seen from the side
props.pine_tree: a single small snow-dusted clay pine tree in a rounded shape
props.lantern: a clay storm lantern with a warm glowing candle inside
props.oven: a chunky clay wood-fired stove with a small arched fire door and a kettle on top
props.whiteboard: a clay-framed whiteboard on stubby legs, blank cream writing surface dusted lightly with snow
props.chart_up: a bar chart pressed from clay on a cream card, four bars rising left to right, a green clay arrow above them
props.chart_down: a bar chart pressed from clay on a cream card, four bars falling left to right, a red clay arrow above them
props.clock: a round clay wall clock with a cream face and stubby sculpted hands
props.coins: a small pile of gold clay nuggets pressed shiny
props.money_bag: a plump beige clay money bag tied at the neck with real-looking sculpted rope
props.wooden_table: a long clay plank table seen from the front, worn sculpted surface
props.workbench: a low clay workbench with tool marks and a small vice at one end, seen from the front
props.mug_of_cocoa: a round clay mug of steaming cocoa with a marshmallow, oversized and cute

_panel_color_note: Cold snow-shadow blue-grey, clearly darker than the cream snow so a panel reads as a sculpted interior wall.
